notes.title: Notice of Bundle Edition Release
notes.content:
In celebration of the 4th anniversary of The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors’ release, the cyborg ninjas are coming to Steam!

A 10% off bundle pack is available with "Pocky & Rocky Reshrined" to coincide with the Steam release of ”THE NINJA SAVIORS RETURN OF THE WARRIORS”!

Please purchase during this special period.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200580/

notes.title: Additional community items
notes.content:
We now support trading cards and other community items.

トレーディングカードなどのコミニュティアイテムに対応いたしました。

notes.title: Update1.0.1
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that screen mode and resolution settings were not initialized when "Restore Settings to Default" was selected in the "Display Settings" option.
・Some display problems have been corrected.

アップデート1.0.1
・オプションの"表示設定"の項目で"初期設定に戻す"を行った際にスクリーンモードと解像度の設定が
　初期化されない不具合を修正致しました。
・一部表示の不具合を修正致しました。
